title: Rollforward-first fallback strategy and incident communication templates for major launches
creator: Maya Johnson
description: Objective: Define a 'rollforward-first' contingency for major Redwood launches that prefers incremental fixes and controlled rollforwards over full rollbacks where safe, plus a suite of pre-approved incident communications (internal + external). This ticket coordinates the decision criteria, automation hooks, monitoring thresholds, stakeholder responsibilities, and templated messages to minimize user-visible downtime and churn during releases. The deliverable is a single canonical checklist and a set of copy-and-paste comms for on-call, product, and customer success teams.
acceptance_criteria: A clear stoplight decision flow (green/amber/red) for launch signals that maps to actions: proceed, hold & mitigate, rollforward patch, or rollback
A documented rollforward play with automated gating for hotfix changes that can reach production inside a launch window (including required approvals and CI checks)
Three incident communication templates: internal incident alert, customer-facing incident status update, and post-resolution explainer
Ownership map for who triggers rollforward vs rollback and who crafts customer comms
End-to-end test of the rollforward path executed in staging and validated by SRE and Product within the cycle
Dashboard widgets and alert rules in place (links in `links`) tied to the stoplight metrics
tasks: Draft stoplight criteria and thresholds for canary metrics (latency p95, error rate, request success ratio, token cost delta)
Define minimal change set allowed for rollforward (size/PR type/hotfix labels)
Create CI gating checklist for rollforward PRs (automated tests, perf smoke, canary deploy plan)
Prepare communication templates and ownership table
Wire up dashboard alerts and automated Slack incident notifier for amber/red transitions
Run simulated rollforward drill during staging deploy and capture learnings
escalation_ladder: Tier 0: On-call engineer — initial triage and amber remediation
Tier 1: SRE lead + Product launch owner — decision to rollforward or rollback
Tier 2: VP Eng + Head of Product — approve full rollback or major mitigation
Exec notify: CTO + Head of GTM when customer-impacting for >30 minutes
stoplight_criteria: Green: p95 latency <= baseline + 10% AND real error rate < 0.5% AND no increase in token per request > 5%
Amber: one of [p95 latency > baseline + 10% for >= 2 min, error rate between 0.5%-2%, sudden token delta > 5%] — hold, investigate, apply mitigations/feature-flag throttles
Red: error rate >= 2% OR p95 latency > baseline + 30% OR major client-visible failures — immediate rollback OR approved rollforward if candidate patch available
rollforward_policy: Allowed when: change set is < 3 files or < 200 LOC, has passing CI, and SRE lead approves via Slack thread with PR link
Must include: quick revert PR pre-created (reverse PR template), clear changelog note, and canary percentage targets
Automation: use feature flag gating + canary job to push to 5% then 25% on success, rollback automatically on failed canary thresholds
rollback_policy: Fallback when: rollforward patch unavailable or fails canary checks OR incident meets red stoplight criteria without safe mitigation
Rollback steps: trigger automated rollback playbook, notify stakeholders via incident channel, open incident timeline doc, and schedule postmortem within 48 hours
Communication: template customer-facing message and support playbook for CS teams
communication_templates: Internal alert (Slack): '[INCIDENT] runtime-1.22 — {{stoplight}} — brief: {{symptom}} — action: {{action}} — owner: {{owner}} — link: {{dashboard}}'

External status (initial): 'We are investigating degraded performance for the Redwood API in region {{region}}. Our engineers are actively working to identify the cause. We will post updates every 15 minutes. Impact: {{impact}}. Workaround: {{workaround}}.'

External status (escalation): 'Update: We have identified a root cause related to {{component}}. A mitigation is being deployed and we expect partial recovery within {{eta}}. We will notify as soon as normal service resumes.'
Post-resolution explainer: 'Service restored. Root cause: {{root_cause}}. Action taken: {{action_taken}}. Customer impact: {{impact_summary}}. Next steps: {{followups}}. Contact: support@redwood.ai.'

Confirm no spike in Support tickets in first 90 minutes (CS dashboard)

Record decision and timelines in the launch timeline doc
